parent_objective: implement high-default asymmetric residual gate after M783 global half-gate failure

public_gates: M786 implements high-default asymmetric residual gate objective
M786 freezes base actor and M761 residual head
M786 reports whether gate escaped global half-scaling
M786 blocks PPO and checkpoint promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not mutate M761 residual head
do not use terminal margin or fault labels as deploy-time inputs
do not hide public active-source pressure
do not claim broad generalization or true four-wheel physical fidelity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether high-default asymmetric loss escapes M783 global half-gate while retaining normal-margin safety
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: implementation diagnostic only; no PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if base actor or residual head checksum changes
stop if gate uses deploy-time oracle inputs
stop if implementation weakens candidate thresholds
fallback_plan: if half-scaling persists, audit and stop scalar-gate branch or pivot to vector residual calibration
if normal collisions return, audit before any coefficient changes
if candidate passes, audit source-diversity and public-overfit risk before another implementation
if hard-negative degradation appears, redesign hard-negative calibration
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M785 admits one asymmetric gate implementation

hypothesis: A high-default asymmetric gate can preserve more intervention residual signal than M783 while retaining strict normal safety on the active low-margin source.
success_criteria: M786 writes run artifacts and docs
M786 confirms actor and residual head checksums unchanged
M786 reports gate statistics and active-source margins
M786 records whether any alpha passes original strict normal and gap gates
failure_criteria: implementation mutates base actor or residual head
implementation omits gate statistics or active source metrics

commands.name: asymmetric_gate_probe
commands.command: implement and run high-default asymmetric residual gate probe; expected run dir runs/m786_v4_asymmetric_residual_gate

decision_rule: M786 may implement and run only a no-PPO asymmetric residual gate probe. It must not mutate the base actor, mutate the M761 residual head, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
